$ cat /etc/ssh/sshd_config.d/00-complianceascode-hardening.conf
GSSAPIAuthentication no
IgnoreRhosts yes
```

The SSH daemon has been reloaded (`systemctl reload sshd`) to apply the change. The OpenSCAP finding **sshd_disable_rhosts** is now compliant.
